name: screenshot_describe
description: Describe what is currently visible on screen; executes nothing, just reports.
prompt: Describe what is currently on screen. Focus: {{focus}}. List the active application, open windows, and important interactive elements (buttons, menus, links) as name + role + approximate location. Do NOT move the mouse or type anything — report in text only. Prefer the accessibility tree; fall back to visual cues from the screenshot when the tree is empty.
